Comparison tables are near-universal at the top: all three domain-authority leaders (Outdoorgearlab, Bikerumor, Cyclist) include sortable or clearly formatted spec tables AND FAQs, treating both as mandatory rather than optional

Tested-and-ranked framing dominates titles: every top-3 result uses 'Tested', 'Ranked', or 'Reviewed' in H1/title, signalling real-world authority — our existing posts use this but inconsistently, and shorter stub posts (1,000–1,300 words) do not

Multi-segment coverage in one URL: Outdoorgearlab and Bikerumor cover MTB, road, gravel, value, and budget tiers in a single mega-guide, capturing all query variants from one authoritative page rather than splitting into separate thin posts
